### Medication pin misses real home **Medium Severity** The Medication sidebar pin now uses `appModeSelectionHref("prescribing")` (`/?mode=prescribing`) instead of the canonical `/medications` workspace. Prescribing is not a consolidated mode: `/medications` is a real standalone home and does not 307 to the shared home. `appModeHomeHref("prescribing")`, the back link, sitemap, and `favourites-auth-gate.dom.test.tsx` still target `/medications`.
Additional Locations (2) - [`tests/ui-smoke.spec.ts#L815-L821`](https://github.com/BigSimmo/Database/blob/3e3138d06ecee7b07479e2dfc86957042a8394b1/tests/ui-smoke.spec.ts#L815-L821) - [`tests/sidebar-production.dom.test.tsx#L87-L88`](https://github.com/BigSimmo/Database/blob/3e3138d06ecee7b07479e2dfc86957042a8394b1/tests/sidebar-production.dom.test.tsx#L87-L88)
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 3e3138d06ecee7b07479e2dfc86957042a8394b1. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Fail when Dev Drive trust is not verified**

On a Windows workstation where the cache is untrusted, the cache path is missing, or `fsutil` fails, `runCheck()` prints a warning and still returns 0, so the new `npm run check:dev-drive-cache` command reports success without verifying the condition it claims to check. Return a nonzero status for `warning`/`untrusted` results and add a self-test that asserts the CLI failure.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep the snapshot-conflict issue open**

When this request is reconciled it archives `#Y090R5`, but the commit still regenerates `data/outstanding-issues-snapshot.json` from every pending request and changes neither the snapshot generator/check nor its clinical-risk classification. Concurrent inbox PRs therefore continue editing the same generated artifact and conflicting exactly as described in `docs/outstanding-issues.md:151`; remove this done request until the shared-file dependency is actually eliminated.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Do not close the unexplained Windows guard failure**

Reconciling this request archives `#BJ80DB`, although its source row records that the hosted-migration guard passed on rerun in 1.55 seconds—nowhere near the prior 30-second budget—and explicitly leaves the cause unexplained. This commit only doubles the suite timeout, without testing the suspected untracked-file/directory or CRLF paths, so it masks a future slow run rather than proving the reported failure resolved; retain the issue until the Windows trigger is reproduced or ruled out.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve the deferred worktree-cleanup task**

When reconciled, this request archives `#6GW95D` as completed even though `docs/outstanding-issues.md:109` says cleanup was deliberately deferred, all 13 removed worktrees were restored, and seven live-process-held directories remain. No cleanup operation or new fleet evidence appears in this commit, so the outcome erases an explicitly outstanding owner decision; remove the done request or replace it with an update that preserves the deferred state.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep the PreCompact context verification open**

This outcome contradicts the checked-in hook: `.claude/hooks/precompact-issues-capture.sh` documents that PreCompact has no `additionalContext` output path and deliberately emits nothing, while `tests/session-start-hook.test.ts` asserts empty stdout. The added test covers only malformed input, not a real compaction or model-context delivery, so reconciling this request would archive the still-unperformed verification recorded at `docs/outstanding-issues.md:107`; retain the task or record the actual log-based result instead.
